title: Man Bites Police Officer After Vandalism Spree
description:
Man Bites Police Officer After Vandalism Spree

On May 17, 2021, a 32-year-old man was charged with a felony count of assaulting an officer after police responded to a vandalism spree in La Crosse, WI. The suspect put the seatbelt in his mouth and bit a Police Officer who tried to remove it.
